investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-07T12:40:59Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm backend ELB at /v1/agents during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the very first network hop to the swarm gateway — before any agent identity, VM ID, or state is returned — all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are absent and every downstream contract assertion is unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" on every POST /api/agents call, preventing agent provisioning from starting. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency, not to the eval runner logic or the expected-output contract definitions. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is confirmed only at the eval/observability layer.
